interface.name: cupertino_semantics_v1

description.summary: publish only the client's own native semantic tree

interface.description: This public interface grants no observation or desktop control. Only the compositor may subscribe an explicitly consented output's eligible surfaces. Publications are bounded immutable sealed JSON memfds. Epochs bind subscriptions to the exact live control run; inactive publications are discarded.

interface.name: cupertino_semantic_surface_v1

description.summary: a surface-owned publication and supported actions

interface.description: One publisher per wl_surface. Each active interest starts a new epoch and requires a full snapshot. The snapshot revision increases for any change, including removals and focus. Node identities are local to this surface's lifetime. Values of protected nodes and actions on those nodes are never published. The compositor validates scope, epoch, publication revision and supported actions before forwarding. The application revalidates the target before routing the action through its native runtime.
